claim: Historical player script positions use rigid-body center coordinates.
reasoning: ScriptParserAPI returns player positions unchanged in both script-to-rigid-body and rigid-body-to-script conversions.
Historical rigid-body broadphase and terrain contact code expands px, py and pz symmetrically by rx, ry and rz.
Therefore the script-visible player position is the center of the collision AABB, not the foot center.
